title: IMA Demo Crash on Open
body:
### Issue description
The Exo IMA Demo crashes on open

### Reproduction steps
1. Upgrade build tools to 3.3.0
2. Sync
3. Run the demo on your phone
### Link to test content
not available

### Version of ExoPlayer being used
Branch dev-v2

### Device(s) and version(s) of Android being used
Motorola Moto Z Play Droid - Motorola XT1635-01(Android 8.0.0, API 26)
com.android.tools.build:gradle:3.3.0
